arStrings.szText: Tyrael sent word of his arrival at the Gea Kul docks. Despite Mephisto's defeat and all our work for peace, we are dragged back to war. The cult of the Úllo Sar remain determined to "end our suffering" by putting humankind to death. And to do so, they have brought back the Reapers. Tyrael fought them long ago. I pray he has a plan.
